entry.title: May 23 2026 Thoughts
entry.summary: Blog entry of my thoughts for the day
entry.content:
Here are some thoughts for the day. Also, I needed something in my Beyond the Terminal category for the nav button to work properly.

Braindump

I've got a lot going on in my head these days...

  • My oldest kids played their last soccer game of the season. They both love it, and our youngest is so ready to start playing.

  • With my BoldApply app idea, I'm going to need to start an LLC.

  • I constantly have a specifc quote on my mind. I'll probably do a whole writeup on it at some point with my thoughts on it.

"You risk so much hesitating to fling yourself into the abyss." - Unknown Monk

I'll have more to talk about later. Maybe if I think of more things later today, I'll add them to this post.

Have a great day ya'll!
